div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
数量、报价、资产标识
检查非负金额、币种、输入时间

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Decimal 市值计算
market_value = quantity × price

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
直接资产
按证券与行业归属计入

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
基金与 ETF
读取已披露成分比例与快照

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
穿透贡献 = 基金市值 × 成分比例
保留快照时点、来源与覆盖比例

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
未穿透金额
基金市值 − 已覆盖贡献合计

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
金额守恒与引用检查
贡献合计 = 原组合金额

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
按资产或行业聚合金额
明确证券与含现金总资产分母

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
组合权重 = 市值 ÷ 总市值 × 100
HHI = 10000 × Σ(value_i ÷ total_value)²
ROUND_HALF_UP 保留两位小数

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
观察比例与画像预算比较
保留观察值、上限和超限幅度
